title: Users
pageDescription: Manage who can sign in to the portal, their roles and the employee record each account is linked to.
notLinkedHint: This account isn’t linked to an employee record. Link it so the user can see their own data and submit requests.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email or mobile…

empty.title: No portal accounts yet
empty.description: Invite employees to the portal or approve their self-registrations.

reasons.superAdminOnly: Only a Super Admin can change a Super Admin account.
reasons.self: You can’t disable your own account.
reasons.cannotInvite: Inviting users requires the Users › Create and Users › Administer permissions.

confirm.disableDescription: The user loses access to all portal data immediately and can’t sign in until the account is enabled again. Their records are kept.
confirm.enableDescription: The user will be able to sign in again with their existing password and roles.
confirm.unlinkDescription: {name} keeps the portal account but will no longer see this employee’s data or be able to submit requests for it.

invite.title: Invite a user
invite.description: The user receives an email to activate the account and set a password.
invite.employeeHint: Link the account to an employee so they can see their own data and submit requests.
invite.languageHint: Used for the invitation email and as the user’s default portal language.

editRoles.title: Edit roles
editRoles.description: Choose what {name} can see and do in the portal.
editRoles.superAdminProtected: This is a Super Admin account. Only a Super Admin can change its roles.
editRoles.selfWarning: You’re editing your own roles. Removing an administrative role takes effect immediately.
editRoles.noRoles: Without any role the user can sign in but won’t see any module.

link.title: Link employee record
link.description: Connect {name} to the employee record it belongs to.
link.hint: Employees already linked to another account can’t be selected.

roles.superAdminLocked: Only a Super Admin can grant or remove this role.

toast.invitedNoEmail: Account created, but the invitation email couldn’t be sent. Check the email settings, then resend the invitation.
toast.approved: Registration approved. The applicant has been notified.
toast.approvedWithoutManager: Registration approved, but the Manager role couldn’t be added. Add it from Users.
toast.rejected: Registration rejected. The applicant has been notified.
toast.infoRequested: Information requested. The applicant has been notified.

errors.superAdminOnly: Only a Super Admin can grant the Super Admin role or change a Super Admin account.
errors.emailInUse: A portal account with this email already exists.
errors.notActive: This action is only available for active accounts.
errors.invitationAccepted: This user has already activated their account. Send a password reset instead.
errors.emailNotConfigured: Email delivery isn’t configured, so the email couldn’t be sent.
errors.cannotChangeSelf: You can’t change the sign-in status of your own account.

email.inviteFallback: You have been invited to {portal}. Use the button below to activate your account and set your password.
email.resetFallback: Use the button below to set a new password for your {portal} account.

portalAccess.title: Portal access
portalAccess.description: Whether this employee can sign in to the portal.
portalAccess.linkedDescription: The portal account linked to this employee.
portalAccess.loadError: Portal access details couldn’t be loaded.
portalAccess.noAccessHint: This employee can’t sign in to the portal yet.
portalAccess.linkDescription: Choose the portal account that belongs to {name}.
portalAccess.linkHint: Only active or disabled accounts that aren’t linked to an employee are listed.

registrations.title: Pending registrations
registrations.description: Review employee self-registrations, link each one to the right employee record and activate access.
registrations.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, mobile or ID…

stats.rejected30d: {count, plural, =0 {None rejected} one {# rejected} other {# rejected}}

pending.title: No registrations waiting
pending.description: New self-registrations will appear here for review.

info_requested.title: No pending information requests
info_requested.description: Registrations waiting for the applicant’s reply will appear here.

rejected.title: No recent rejections
rejected.description: Registrations rejected recently will appear here.

sheet.matchLinked: This employee is already linked to another portal account. Pick a different employee when approving.
sheet.noSuggestion: No employee record matches the ID entered. You can still pick the right employee when approving.

approve.title: Approve registration
approve.description: Activate {name}’s account and link it to their employee record.
approve.employeeSuggested: Pre-selected from the ID the applicant entered. Change it if it’s not the right person.
approve.employeeHint: Search by name, employee ID or company email.
approve.noEmployeeWarning: Without an employee link the user can sign in but can’t see personal data or submit requests. You can link it later.
approve.alsoManagerHint: For line managers who approve their team’s requests.

reject.title: Reject registration
reject.description: {name} will be notified by email with the reason below.
reject.label: Reason
reject.placeholder: Explain why the registration can’t be approved…

info.title: Request more information
info.description: Tell {name} what to correct or add. They can update their details and resubmit.
info.label: Message to the applicant
info.placeholder: For example: please enter your employee ID exactly as it appears on your contract…
info.visibility: The applicant sees this message and receives it by email.
